cohort: Women who underwent vaginal delivery or cesarean section at a public hospital in southern Brazil with gestational age >20 weeks and/or fetuses weighing > 500 g.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 39.1%, with Robson Classification Groups 1, 2, and 5 together accounting for 60.3% of all cesarean sections.
mod_finding: A greater incidence of cesarean sections was identified among women with no previous vaginal births, older age, higher educational levels, and more previous cesarean sections.
